'''''The March to Restuss''''' was the title of a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at some point after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was the winner of the [[Rebel Alliance Painting Contest]]; after the work earned this accolade, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Navari Trik]] gave out copies of the work to anyone who requested them in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. In a restricted palette of [[Color/Legends|orange]] and black, the painting depicted a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] marching to the ruins of the city of [[Restuss]] on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''The March to Restuss'' is a painting that appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment. It was the winning Rebel entry in the "[[Create a Painting]]" contest held by Sony in [[2008]]. Its [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] equivalent is ''[[United in Our Cause]]''. ''The March to Restuss'' was created by the player [[Guillemette]] of the Bria server; the work was added to the game as part of ''Game Update 5'' on [[July 29]], 2008. It could be used in the player character's home as decoration.
